note: A blessing for your week: a cozy, seasonal still life with a blessing line in our words, then the verse card. The first Sunday of a month says Hello, <Month>.
style: A warm, cozy lifestyle still-life photograph with the polish of a top lifestyle feed: soft natural window light, shallow depth of field, rich natural colors, subtle film grain, photorealistic. No people, no text, no letters, no logos and no brand marks anywhere.
cta: Send this to someone you are praying for.

autumn: a knitted toy fox sitting on a wooden windowsill beside a steaming mug, autumn leaves outside a rain-speckled window
a candle, an open Bible with soft blurred pages and a cup of coffee on a wooden table, autumn leaves and morning light
a cozy reading corner with a plaid blanket, a mug of cocoa and a small pumpkin by a window in autumn rain
winter: a mug of cocoa with marshmallows by a frosty window, soft snow falling outside, a candle glowing
an open Bible with soft blurred pages beside a candle and a knit scarf, snow outside the window
spring: a vase of tulips beside an open window with morning light and a cup of tea
a picnic blanket with a basket of strawberries and wildflowers in soft spring light
summer: a glass of iced tea with lemon on a porch rail at golden hour, a garden behind
an open Bible with soft blurred pages on a beach towel beside sunglasses and seashells

framing: Vertical 4:5 frame; the objects sit low in the frame with soft, clear background above them for a title. One single continuous photograph, never a collage or split frame.
lines: May it bring you slow mornings, good news, and a peace that holds.
May your week hold small mercies and quiet strength.
May you find Him in the ordinary moments of this week.
May you rest well, and rise ready.

entries.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children. May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
